# pve_cluster_firewall_options (Data Source)

Reads the cluster-wide firewall options singleton from `GET /cluster/firewall/options`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cluster-wide firewall options.
data "pve_cluster_firewall_options" "cluster" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ebtables` (Boolean) Enable ebtables rules cluster wide.
- `enable` (Number) Enable or disable the firewall cluster wide. Must be at least 0.
- `id` (String) Singleton identifier for the cluster firewall options; always `cluster`.
- `log_ratelimit` (String) Log ratelimiting settings as a PVE property string: `[enable=]<1|0> [,burst=<integer>] [,rate=<rate>]`, e.g. `enable=1,burst=5,rate=1/second`.
- `policy_forward` (String) Forward policy. Must be one of: `ACCEPT`, `DROP`.
- `policy_in` (String) Input policy. Must be one of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`.
- `policy_out` (String) Output policy. Must be one of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`.
